deck: STACK ELIGIBLE COMMERCIAL CARD & PORTAL REBATES
site_ui.lead: Turn documented tax-exempt wholesale buying-group commitments into margin through eligible uncapped 2%–4% commercial-card and shopping-portal rebates, targeting up to 55 days of treasury float under qualifying terms.
site_ui.summary: Validate BuyForMeRetail/Pointsmaker commitments and current warehouse instructions before routing purchases to DE/NH/OR addresses, confirming applicable sales-tax treatment and Rakuten/TopCashback eligibility before counting stacked rebates. Use Plastiq/Melio only for permitted B2B payments where card acceptance, fees and issuer terms support the float, then optimize bank/T-bill sweep velocity around cleared proceeds, bonus requirements and payment deadlines.

flow: Confirm buyer reliability, written commitments, permitted sourcing, warehouse instructions and applicable tax documentation.
Calculate net margin after fulfillment costs, payment fees and financing costs; treat unconfirmed rebates and bonuses as contingent.
Activate an eligible portal offer, retain tracking evidence and pay with a qualifying commercial card within approved limits.
Route committed goods to the approved warehouse, meet delivery deadlines and document receipt, acceptance and payout eligibility.
Match settlement dates to actual card due dates; use permitted Plastiq/Melio payments only when fees and terms preserve positive economics.
Reserve repayment cash, sweep only suitable surplus into banks or maturity-matched T-bills, and reconcile payouts, rebates, bonuses and reversals.
